name: Libraries & Museums Finance Internships
focus: Finance, accounting, endowment/investment-office, development, and treasury internships at libraries, museums, archives, and cultural institutions (100+ swept) — part-time and virtual roles compatible with the 2026-27 school year flagged; pay (incl. unpaid/stipend) noted per role
competitiveness_note: Cultural-sector finance internships are niche: fewer applicants than Wall Street pipelines, but few open seats and many are unpaid or stipend-based. Museums with real endowment/investment offices (Getty, Met, Smithsonian) are the most competitive.
